We talk about WiFi Sensing and how ISPs, like Comcast via Xfinity Shield, are starting to roll out WiFi sensing services that detect occupancy and presence of people in a home. This data can be valuable beyond the marketed use (which is normally security), and becomes a potential vector to tie even more data into an advertising profile. Wendell also has concerns regarding the judicial process. In this discussion, we cover WiFi sensing and how routers can detect the presence of people in their vicinity.
